source_title: Uttar Pradesh Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Kaushal Prashikshan Evam Rozgar Kshetra Vikas Yojana - GovtSchemes.in
source_excerpt:
Trains youth in skills that industries actually need.
Offers basic training for arts and commerce youth and technical upskilling for ITI, polytechnic and engineering youth.
Teaches Indian and foreign languages for jobs in other states and abroad.
Provides hostels and on-campus placement support at each centre.
Domestic and overseas employment opportunities.
The Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Kaushal Prashikshan Evam Rozgar Kshetra Vikas Yojana is a new skill training and employment scheme of the Uttar Pradesh government. It aims to provide industry-oriented skill training and improve employment opportunities for youth across Uttar Pradesh. The state government has announced plans to launch the scheme on 31 October 2026, with an initial focus on establishing skill training and employment centres in five cities.
The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Department , Uttar Pradesh, has prepared the scheme. It plans to cover all 75 districts by organising them into nine zones. The initiative aims to align skill training with local industries, market demand and employment opportunities so that young people can develop skills that meet employers' requirements.
Under the proposed programme, candidates with ITI, polytechnic and engineering qualifications may receive technical skill training and upgradation. The scheme also plans to provide basic skill training to youth from non-technical backgrounds, including humanities and commerce, along with Indian and foreign language training based on job requirements. Young people who want to start their own businesses instead of seeking jobs can also explore the Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yuva Udhyami Vikas Abhiyan (CM-YUVA) .
The proposed skill training centres will include hostel facilities, employment offices and placement cells. The government also plans to connect trained candidates with recognised placement agencies and employment opportunities in India and abroad. Digital dashboards, data analytics and artificial intelligence-based tools will help monitor training activities and employment outcomes.
The Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Kaushal Prashikshan Evam Rozgar Kshetra Vikas Yojana will be launched in phases. The first-phase centres are planned for Lucknow, Kanpur, Gorakhpur, Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida) and Jhansi. The scheme is intended for youth seeking skill development and employment opportunities. However, the government has not yet confirmed the detailed eligibility criteria, required documents, individual application procedure or any fixed financial assistance through publicly verified scheme guidelines.
Interested candidates should visit the Uttar Pradesh MSME Department website for updates on the scheme, registration announcements and official implementation guidelines.
Here are the key benefits of the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Kaushal Prashikshan Evam Rozgar Yojana for Uttar Pradesh youth, as approved by the state Cabinet.
Provides skill training according to local industrial activity, market demand and employment potential in each zone.
Offers basic skill training opportunities for youth from non-technical backgrounds, including humanities and commerce.
Plans to provide technical skill training and upgradation for youth with ITI, polytechnic and engineering qualifications.
Provides for Indian and foreign language training according to employment requirements in other states and abroad.
Plans to provide hostel facilities for trainees at the skill training centres.
Provides for employment offices and placement cells within the training centre campuses to support job placement.
Aims to connect trained candidates with employment opportunities through recognised placement agencies in India and abroad.
Plans to establish training centres across nine zones to improve access for youth from all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh.
Plans to use digital dashboards, data analytics and artificial intelligence-based tools to monitor training activities and employment outcomes.
Note: These benefits reflect the announced objectives and proposed facilities of the scheme. The detailed implementation guidelines have not yet been verified. The government has not confirmed any fixed cash assistance, stipend or guaranteed employment for individual beneficiaries.
All 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh are divided into the following nine zones.
Zone 1: Gautam Buddh Nagar, Ghaziabad and Hapur
Zone 2: Saharanpur division, plus Bulandshahr, Baghpat and Meerut
Zone 7: Chitrakoot, Vindhyachal and Jhansi divisions
Zone 9: Gorakhpur, Basti and Devipatan divisions
First Phase: Centres and Implementing Bodies
One skill training and employment centre will be set up at each of these five places in the first phase.
Kanpur: set up through the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.
Gorakhpur: set up by the Gorakhpur Industrial Development Authority (GIDA).
Gautam Buddh Nagar: set up jointly by the Noida, Greater Noida and Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authorities.
Jhansi: set up by the Bundelkhand Industrial Development Authority (BIDA).
Each centre will get 10 to 25 acres of suitable, encumbrance-free land.
Centres are to be within 20 km of the district headquarters, as reported by Dainik Jagran.
A four-lane road link to the nearest highway or expressway is to be provided within two years.
Centres will be built and run through a PPP-based Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Transfer (DBFOT) model, or through government institutions.
Under the PPP route, a Special Purpose Vehicle will be formed and land will be given on a 99-year lease, as reported by Dainik Jagran. The master developer must finish construction in three years. The contract can be cancelled if work is not completed in five years.
The master developer must finish construction in three years.
The contract can be cancelled if work is not completed in five years.
Private developers and training providers may get Viability Gap Funding (VGF) where needed.
Monitoring will happen at state, district and project levels.
The Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Kaushal Prashikshan Evam Rozgar Yojana plans to offer technical, non-technical and foreign-language training based on industry needs. The government has not yet confirmed the official eligibility criteria. However, applicants may need to meet the following conditions:
The applicant should be a young person seeking skill training or employment opportunities.
The applicant may need to be a resident of Uttar Pradesh, subject to the final scheme guidelines.
The applicant should meet the educational qualifications prescribed for the selected training course.
Applicants with ITI, diploma, engineering, humanities or commerce backgrounds may be eligible for suitable courses, depending on the training programme.
The applicant should be willing to participate in the prescribed skill training programme.
The applicant may need to provide valid identity proof and educational certificates during registration.
Applicants must fulfil any additional age, residence or course-specific conditions notified by the government or the designated training centre.
Note: The above conditions are tentative and are not an official eligibility list. The minimum and maximum age limits, domicile requirements, educational qualifications and other admission conditions will need to be confirmed from the official scheme guidelines when they become available.
The Uttar Pradesh Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Kaushal Prashikshan Evam Rojgar Kshetra Vikas Yojana aims to provide industry-oriented skill training and employment opportunities to young people. The government has not yet confirmed the official document checklist. Applicants may need the following documents during registration and admission to a training programme:
Aadhaar Card or other valid identity proof.
Uttar Pradesh domicile certificate or residence proof.
Educational certificates and mark sheets.
Class 10th and 12th certificates, where applicable.
ITI, diploma, graduation or engineering certificates, if applicable to the selected course.
Bank account details, if required for any approved training-related financial benefit.
Caste certificate, if applicable and required under the admission rules.
Disability certificate, if applicable and required for the selected training programme.
Experience certificate, if required for a particular course or placement opportunity.
Note: This is a tentative list prepared from the proposed objectives of the scheme, not an official checklist. Applicants should follow the final document requirements issued by the Uttar Pradesh government or the designated training centre when the application guidelines become available.
No online or offline application process has been announced for this scheme yet. Here is how to stay updated on how to apply for the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Kaushal Prashikshan Evam Rozgar Kshetra Vikas Yojana.
The Uttar Pradesh government has announced that the scheme will be launched on 31 October 2026.
Visit the official Uttar Pradesh MSME Department website to check for scheme-related announcements.
Check whether the government has published the official scheme guidelines, eligibility criteria and registration instructions.
Once the application process opens, follow the instructions issued by the designated department or training centre.
Complete the registration form through the officially notified application portal or apply through the prescribed offline process, if applicable.
Provide the required personal details, educational qualifications and supporting documents as specified in the official guidelines.
Submit the application and retain the acknowledgement or registration number for future reference, if provided.
Follow the official instructions regarding document verification, training-centre allotment, admission and placement support.
Note: The steps above provide general guidance and are not a confirmed application procedure for this scheme. The official registration portal, application dates, document verification process and admission rules have not yet been verified. Applicants should wait for the government's formal instructions before submitting an application.
The concerned authority has not shared any helpline number for scheme yet.
1. What is the Uttar Pradesh Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Kaushal Prashikshan Evam Rojgar Kshetra Vikas Yojana?
The Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Kaushal Prashikshan Evam Rojgar Kshetra Vikas Yojana is a Uttar Pradesh government initiative that aims to provide industry-oriented skill training and improve employment opportunities for youth.
2. When will the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Kaushal Prashikshan Evam Rojgar Kshetra Vikas Yojana be launched?
The Uttar Pradesh government has announced plans to launch the scheme on 31 October 2026.
3. Who can benefit from the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Kaushal Prashikshan Evam Rojgar Kshetra Vikas Yojana?
The scheme aims to benefit youth seeking skill training and employment opportunities. The government has not yet confirmed the detailed eligibility criteria.
4. What types of training will the scheme provide?
The proposed programme includes technical skill training, basic training for non-technical candidates, technical skill upgradation and Indian and foreign language training according to employment requirements.
5. Which cities will have training centres in the first phase?
The first-phase training centres are planned for Lucknow, Kanpur, Gorakhpur, Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida) and Jhansi.
6. Will the scheme provide employment opportunities abroad?
Yes, the scheme aims to connect trained candidates with employment opportunities in India and abroad through recognised placement agencies. However, job placement is not confirmed as a guarantee for every trainee.
7. Will trainees receive hostel facilities?
The proposed skill training centres are expected to include hostel facilities for trainees. The final arrangements will depend on the official implementation guidelines.
8. Is a job guaranteed after completing training under this scheme?
No guarantee has been announced. The scheme provides placement cells and links with placement agencies. Actual hiring will depend on employers.
9. Can a student from arts or commerce join this scheme?
Yes. The scheme provides basic skill training to youth from humanities and commerce backgrounds. ITI, polytechnic and engineering students will get technical skill upgradation.
10. Will the scheme provide financial assistance or a stipend?
The government has not confirmed any fixed cash assistance or stipend for individual beneficiaries under this scheme.
